title: semantic-scholar-mcp: an MCP server for the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph
description: A FastMCP stdio server exposing the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph (Allen Institute for AI) as nine tools returning one typed JSON response envelope (searched term and script, matching mode, breadth, typed diagnostics, receipt, attribution). Envelopes can be deposited to an append-only, hash-chained receipt ledger. Works with any MCP-compatible client.
